The Respondents 1&2 as
complainants filed a complaint before the District Forum, Coimbatore, alleging deficiency against the
opposite parties 1 to 3 to pay a sum of
Rs.40,954/- with interest at 24% p.a. from the date of the petition till
payment, directing the opposite parties 2 and 3 to return the service charges
of Rs.460/- collected from the complainants,
to pay Rs.5,000/- towards the cost of these proceedings. The District Forum, allowed the complaint
against the opposite parties 1 and 2. Against
the said order, this appeal is preferred by the 1st opposite party, praying
to set aside the order of the District Forum, Coimbatore, dated 23.01.08 in COP.No.7/2008. 

 

  

 

This appeal coming before us for
hearing finally on 10.05.2011, upon hearing the arguments of the counsel on both
sides and perused the documents, written submissions as well as the order of
the District Forum, this Commission made the following order :- 

 

  

 

Counsel
for the Appellant/1st Opposite party :
Mr.A.Palaniappan, Advocate. 

 

Counsel
for the Respondents 1&2/Complainants 1&2 : Mr.N.Manoharan,
Advocate. 

 

Counsel
for the Respondents 3&4/Opp.parties 2 &3 :
Absent. 

 

  

 

 ORDER
A.K.ANNAMALAI, PRESIDING MEMBER JUDICIAL
1. 1st
opposite party is the appellant.
2. The complainant filed a complaint against
the opposite parties 1 to 3 for deficiency of service and for refund of Rs.40,954/-
towards air ticket fare for cancellation of service and Rs.460/- as service
charges and Rs.5000/- for the costs.
3. The brief details of the complaint are
as follows :- The 1st
complainant is an advocate practicing at Coimbatore
the 2nd complainant is the daughter of the 1st
complainant. The 2nd
complainant who is a doctor had to write an examination namely MRCOG Part I at
Bombay on 7.3.05 therefore they have decided to go by air to Bombay on 6.3.05,
approached the 3rd opposite party on 13.12.04 and arranged through
the 2nd opposite party who confirmed tickets from Chennai to Mumbai
for 6.3.05 and two confirm tickets for return journey on 8.3.05. The total fare comes to Rs.7520/- and the 2nd
opposite party and 3rd opposite party collected Rs.7980/- including
their service charges of Rs.460/-. Both
the complainants have also reserved for train tickets from Coimbatore
to Chennai and for the return journey in accordance with the flight timings and
the rooms also were booked at Bombay. But suddenly about 10 days before scheduled
flight dates the first opposite party phoned to the complainant and said that
all flights from 5.3.05 to 15.3.05 were cancelled. With great difficulty the complainants
managed to buy 2 tickets in Air India
for both journey by paying at a total cost of Rs.15,914/-. As the timings of the flights changed the
train tickets also cancelled and room reservation at Mumbai also had to be
modified. No specific reason had been
given by the 1st opposite party for the cancellation excepting to
say that it was due to administrative reasons.
The first opposite party has collected a huge amounts running to several
crores of rupees from the public and announces that the flights are being
cancelled. It is nothing but straight
cheating of the public and also amounts to deficiency of service. The opposite party has not only the public
and also amounts to deficiency of service.
The opposite party has not only return the fare but also the entire
extra amount. The 2nd and 3rd
opposite parties are colluding with 1st opposite party in defrauding
the public, hence they are also liable to pay compensation. In its reply the 1st opposite
party has said that it has returned the fare to the complainant, but it is
false. Even after receiving notice, the
opposite parties did not even send any reply the 2nd and 3rd
opposite parties and pleaded that they are only agents. Hence this complaint.
4. 1st opposite party has denied
the allegation of complainant in their written version by stating that the
complaint is false, frivolous and vexatious.
The complainant booked two return tickets through travel agents to
travel on Chennai-Mumbai-Chennai sector on 6.3.05 and 8.3.05 respectively. The travel agent collected total basic fare
and the tax Rs.7520/- on behalf of this opposite party. Due to some technical (fore-majeure) reasons
this respondent was made to cancel the flights on the above said date and
intimation of the same was given to the complainants on 22.2.05. Hence 10 days advance information was given
to the complainant to making for alternative arrangements. Further the fare and Taxes amount Rs.7200/-
has been refunded in full by this opposite party on 2.3.05. Hence there is no cause of action for this
complaint. The complainants themselves
admitted that they were informed about 10 days before. The flights were cancelled due to technical
reasons which were beyond the control of the opposite parties.
5. It is pertinent to mention herein that
keeping in view such eventualities specific terms and conditions have been
mentioned in the contract between opposite parties airlines and its passengers
that in case of cancellation or delay of the flight the airlines is not liable
to accommodate the passengers in other airlines.
6. The opposite party airlines has taken all
care and caution to avoid inconvenience of its passengers they were informed
very well in advance and the complainants had sufficient time to make
alternative arrangements. As per the
terms and conditions of the contract between Air Deccan and passengers Air
Deccan has to right delay or to cancel the flight without notice.
7. The cancellation of the flight was
neither intentional nor deliberate but the same was for the reasons stated
above. The complainants had got their
booking through travel agents and the opposite party has refunded the amount on
2.3.05. It is denied that the
complainants are entitled to claim the money referred in para under reply nor
any such demand notice received by the answering opposite party airlines. In view of the above facts the present
complaint is liable to be dismissed with exemplary costs.
8. 3rd opposite party has denied
the allegations of complainant in their written version by stating that it is
true that the complainant approached them and got tickets for flight No.DN 613
leaving Chennai on 6.3.05 and for the return journey in flight No.DN614 leaving
Mumbai on 8.5.05. The flight 613 and 614
was cancelled by the 1st 1st opposite party has denied
the allegation of complainant in their written version by stating that the due
to unforeseen circumstances and intimation was given to the complainant 10 days
well in advance. However the claim of
Rs.40,954/- and other reliefs are excessive and the complainant is not entitled
for the same. The 1st
opposite party has denied the allegation of complainant in their written
version by stating that the opposite party is only sub agent and their roll is
very limited and this opposite party collected ticket from 2nd
opposite party who were the tickets receiving authorities. This opposite party is no way responsible and
there is no deficiency of service on their part.
9. On the basis of both sides materials and
after an enquiry the District Forum allowed the complaint by directing the
opposite parties 1 and 2 to pay a sum of Rs.40,954/- with interest at the rate
of 12% and to return Rs.460/- as service charges from 2nd opposite
party and Rs.1,000/- towards costs.
10. Aggrieved by the order of the District
Forum, the 1st opposite party came forward with this appeal and in
the amended grounds of appeal among other things it is stated that the District
Forum failed to consider the terms and conditions of the document Exhibit B1
since the cancellation was intimated 10 days prior to the travel and there was
no deficiency of service. The
cancellation of flight neither intentional nor deliberate, but the same was
cancelled due to unforeseen reasons which were beyond the control of the
airlines. The District Forum allowed the
complaint against the reported rulings an thereby appeal to be allowed.
11. In the appeal Respondents 3 and 4 remained
absent.
12. While considering the appellants and as
well as Respondents 1 and 2 arguments, averments and contentions it is the
admitted case of both sides that the complainants have purchased air tickets
for the travel from Chennai to Mumbai on 6.3.05 and for return ticket from
Mumbai to Chennai on 8.3.2005 by paying Rs.7,980/-, + Rs.640/- as service charges. It is also not in dispute that the flight was
cancelled and the complainants were informed well in advance 10 days earlier to
their proposed journeys. The cancellation
was said to be due to unforeseen reasons beyond their control. The complainants have claimed the refund of
tickets fares already made to the 1st opposite party to the 3rd
opposite party and also further amounts spent for traveling in other flight
with higher rates of flight charges with other expenses. The District Forum considered the facts and
circumstances of the case and ordered for their refund of entire claim
including the extra amounts spent by the complainants and the service charges
also. This was vehemently opposed by the
appellant by stating that the cancellation of flight was informed at the
earliest point of time and the District Forum in spite of that awarded for the
expenses for which the opposite parties are not liable to pay and further as
the cancellation of flight was due to unforeseen circumstances and beyond the
control of the airlines. But the
complainants have claimed that simply they have cancelled the flight without
assigning any proper reason except to state that the cancellation was due to
beyond their control and thereby complainants were met to suffer by arranging
for alternative travel by other flight and trains by canceling earlier
arrangements and thereby they are entitled for the claim as made for.
13. While considering both sides contentions
and arguments it is not in dispute that the complainants were earlier informed
about the cancellation of flight well in advance that is prior to 10 days of
their journey and thereby it cannot be considered as deficiency of service and
in those circumstances at the most the complainants are entitled for the refund
of entire ticket fare amount including service charges. Even though inconvenience is caused due to
various regulations and control depending upon various circumstances and those
circumstances the airlines are bound to stick on them and accordingly the
cancellation of flights for particular point of time cannot be blamed as only
because of due to their negligence and deficiency of service unless it is
proved. In this case there was no such
deficiency of service or negligence, in view of the cancellation of flight was
informed well in advance to the complainant and in those circumstances the
complainants are entitled only for the refund of actual fare charges alone
which they have made, and not for any other amounts for which they have spent
subsequently even after of intimation of cancellation made well in advance and
in the circumstances the District Forum ought not to have ordered for other
amount as claimed by the complainants and in those circumstances, the order of
the District Forum requires to be modified.
Further the respondents 1 and 2 also relied upon the ruling made in Appeal
No.A 08/305 in the State Commission, Delhi in the similar case Air
Deccan Vs Mr.Ajay Coil, in which
it is stated as follows :-
10. Service providers like Airlines little
realize that their inefficiency of casual or cavalier attitude towards the
passengers causes immense mental agony, harassment, emotional suffering,
trauma, physical discomfort to the passengers at large as they are left
stranded for hours together without any food or eatables and when the consumes
ask for refund of the cancelled flight or changed flight, they make him run
from pillar to post and offer him half of the price of the ticket. No service provider can be allowed to usurp
the consideration received by it in case it has either not provided the service
or the consumer has not availed the service.
Any such term of contract allowing the service provider to forfeit or
recover the charges is unconscionable terms of contract and therefore void ab
initio.
11. In the
instant case the excuse that the flights were not operational from 1st
May to 31st May, 2007 from Bombay to Delhi was as on verification on
27th April, 2007 from the check on site was found to be untrue as
the flights were quite operational and therefore the allegation of the
respondent that the appellant was accentuated by agreed booked costly go air flight for return journey by
canceling Air Deccan flight for which ticket cost them Rs.7,650/-.
and further the
compensation awarded by the District Forum was confirmed. But in our case the District Forum have not
awarded any separate compensation and awarded the paymnt of Rs.40,954/- with
interest and Rs.1000/- as cost apart from the service charges of Rs.460/- to be
payable by the 2nd opposite party.
Even though the above ruling is
relied upon for awarding compensation in our case as the deficiency of service
against opposite parties 1 and 2 are not proved as dismissed above we consider
to allow only for the refund of actual fare with costs.
14. In the
result, the appeal is allowed in part by modifying the order of the District
Forum, Coimbatore in COP.No.7/2008 dated 23.01.08, as follows :-
a) The opposite
parties 1 and 2 are directed to pay a sum of Rs.7980/- to the complainants
towards the ticket fare paid for the purchase of air tickets if the same amount
is already not returned with 12% of interest from the ate of complaint till
date of realization.
b) The 2nd
opposite party is directed to pay a sum of Rs.460/- towards service charges
collected from the complainant.
c) The
opposite parties shall pay a sum of Rs.1,000/- towards costs to the
complainant.
d) In
other respects the order of the District Forum is set aside.
e) The
opposite parties shall comply the direction within two months from the date of
this order and
f) There will be no order as to cost in this
appeal.
VASUGI RAMANAN A.K.ANNAMALAI, 

 

 MEMBER PRESIDING MEMBER JUDICIAL
